name: WordWorld sixth fresh 50-command evaluation — 2026-10-15
method: 50 newly hand-authored commands and expected actions frozen before first prediction after partition/passive/predicate fixes. Author saw implementation and prior errors; not independently human-labeled or randomly sampled. No tuning on round-six predictions.
scope: 40 preassigned core cases and 10 broader probes. Core includes zero/negated groups and a zero-total refusal. Comma partitions replace implicit defaults; declared totals must match group sums. Adjacent and groups remain additions; omitted colors follow the existing noun-type inheritance contract. Trailing locations apply to the groups. Size rendering, geometry and cross-request reference are not scored.
evaluation_kind: retest after parser development; not unseen-command accuracy

metric_definitions.exact_match: Complete ordered action dictionaries match, including all emitted fields; per command over all 50.
metric_definitions.intent: Ordered action-name sequence matches; per command over all 50. Does not validate entity or setting value.
metric_definitions.entity_count_color: Ordered (action, type, count, color) tuples for all typed actions match, per command over all 50. Pure setting/no-op cases contribute empty typed-action lists.
metric_definitions.spatial: Ordered (type, relation, target, targets) tuples for all typed actions match, on gold-spatial commands only. Extra subjects are penalized.
metric_definitions.settings: Ordered (key, value) tuples for setting actions match, on gold-setting commands only.
